trans-unit.source: The activity timeline’s summary for emails saved as tasks is enriched when Enhanced Email is turned on. There are limitations in the activity timeline when logging emails as tasks from Lightning for Outlook and Inbox.
trans-unit.target: 启用“增强型电子邮件”后,保存为任务的电子邮件的活动时间线摘要会更加丰富。从 Lightning for Outlook 和 Inbox 将电子邮件记录为任务时,活动时间线存在一些限制。

trans-unit.source: Salesforce sets your package API access privileges to Unrestricted. You can change this setting to further restrict API access of Salesforce components in the package. For more information, see Manage API and Dynamic Apex Access in Packages.
trans-unit.target: Salesforce 会将您的包 API 访问权限设置为不受限制。您可以更改此设置,以进一步限制包中 Salesforce 组件的 API 访问。有关详细信息,请参阅管理包中的 API 和动态 Apex 访问。
trans-unit.note: [error] ui_label: UI label <parmname>Unrestricted</parmname> must be translated as "不受限"

trans-unit.source: To remove a member from the library, click Remove. To change a member's library permission, click Edit and choose a new library permission from the drop-down list.
trans-unit.target: 要从库中移除成员,请单击移除。要更改成员的库权限,请单击编辑,然后从下拉列表中选择新的库权限。
trans-unit.note: [error] ui_label: UI label <uicontrol>Remove</uicontrol> must be translated as "删除"

trans-unit.source: Deleting campaign member record types updates the Campaign Member Type field on campaign and campaign member records.
trans-unit.target: 删除营销活动成员记录类型会更新营销活动和营销活动成员记录上的营销活动成员类型字段。
trans-unit.note: [error] ui_label: UI label <parmname>Campaign Member Type</parmname> must be translated as "市场活动成员类型"

trans-unit.source: If selected, the named org allows change sets to be sent to it from the org you are currently logged into.
trans-unit.target: 如果选中,指定的组织将允许从您当前登录的组织向其发送变更集。
trans-unit.note: [error] terminology: Term "change sets" must be translated as "更改集", none found in target

trans-unit.source: This component provides similar functionality to the Case Milestone tracker in Salesforce Classic. To add this component, your org must have entitlements, an entitlement process, and milestones set up. The component supports only Case Milestones and doesn’t support Object Milestones. You can add it only to case pages.
trans-unit.target: 此组件提供的功能与 Salesforce Classic 中的案例里程碑跟踪器类似。要添加此组件,您的组织必须已设置权利、权利流程和里程碑。该组件仅支持案例里程碑,不支持对象里程碑。您只能将其添加到案例页面。
trans-unit.note: [error] terminology: Term "Case" must be translated as "个案", none found in target

trans-unit.source: Since Kimmy added the topics Sales Training, Western Region, and Feedback Request to her post, these topics are also added to the file she attached. Now, her coworkers can click a topic to find other posts, files, and records associated with that topic. If the topic is associated with records other than files, go to the Records tab and choose Files. Otherwise, use the Feeds tab to see all posts and files for the topic.
trans-unit.target: 由于 Kimmy 在her 帖子中添加了主题 Sales Training、Western Region 和 Feedback Request,这些主题也会添加到她附加的文件中。现在,她的同事可以单击某个主题来查找与该主题相关联的其他帖子、文件和记录。如果该主题与文件以外的记录相关联,请转到记录选项卡并选择文件。否则,请使用动态选项卡查看该主题的所有帖子和文件。
trans-unit.note: [error] ui_label: UI label <uicontrol>Feed</uicontrol> must be translated as "摘要"
